modules.name: GroupNorm
modules.notes: NCHW group normalization with affine parameters; PyTorch fixtures cover forward and gradients.

modules.name: BatchNorm2d
modules.notes: NCHW training/eval with running statistics, num_batches_tracked and PyTorch parity fixtures.

modules.name: AvgPool2d
modules.notes: CHW/NCHW with ceil mode, count_include_pad and divisor_override; forward and gradients covered by PyTorch fixtures.

modules.name: MaxPool2d
modules.notes: NCHW with ceil mode, dilation and padding; gradients covered by PyTorch fixtures.

modules.name: AdaptiveAvgPool2d
modules.notes: CHW/NCHW adaptive average pooling; forward and gradients covered by oracle fixtures.

modules.name: GELU
modules.notes: Exact erf form and tanh approximation; oracle fixtures cover forward and gradients.

modules.notes: Integer-index lookup with padding_idx; sparse gradients are rejected.

modules.notes: Delegates to the sigmoid operator.

modules.notes: PyTorch default start_dim=1.

modules.notes: Positional child names match PyTorch state dict keys.

modules.notes: mean/sum/none reductions; parameterless criterion.

modules.notes: 2-D logits and int64 class targets only.
